definitions.explanation: People who belong to the same group, share the same interests, or work together. Implies a sense of camaraderie and belonging.
Things that belong to the same category or type. Used for classification.

{仲間|なかま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {仲間|なかま} implies a stronger bond than just 'friend'. It suggests people who share experiences, goals, or a sense of belonging together.

NUANCES:
・Implies solidarity and loyalty
・Often used for teammates, colleagues, or fellow group members
・Can indicate being 'one of us'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{仲間|なかま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to join a group)
・{仲間|なかま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to include in the group)
・{仲間|なかま}⟦{外|はず}れ→外れ：10487_hazure⟧ (being left out, ostracism)
・{仲間|なかま}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ (sense of belonging)
・〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲間|なかま} (belonging to the ~ category/group)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ - friend (general)
・⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧ - colleague (work)
・⟦{仲良|なかよ}し→仲良し：11449_nakayoshi⟧ - close friend
・⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧ - fellow (suffix)
